اعتنقنا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَنَقْنَا (iʕtanaqnā) /iʕ.ta.naq.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# اُعْتُنِقْنَا (uʕtuniqnā) /uʕ.tu.niq.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
